instructions.summary: Draft the remediation proposal for this Issue.
instructions.details: Read the Root Issue and write the proposal you would hand to an implementer, then reply on this task with a comment that opens with the WorkGraph mention and states the proposal in your own words.
acceptanceCriteria: The proposal names the change being proposed.
The proposal states why the change is needed.
The proposal lists the checks that would prove it worked.

instructions.summary: Normalize the verified Root Issue into a structured summary.
instructions.details: Read the Root Issue title and body returned by the reporter and restate them as a normalized summary. Use only what the Root Issue says; do not infer, judge, or add anything it does not state.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary restates the Root Issue title.
The summary restates what the Root Issue body asks for.
The summary adds no claim the Root Issue does not make.
